papers.title_en: Multi-Agent Path Planning via Compatible Encounter-Space Allocation in Crowded Spaces Dynamically Occupied by Work Activities
papers.authors: Boda Liu, Xuezhi Yang, Bin Yang, Shu Li
papers.evidence: 兼容相遇空间分配的终身多智能体路径规划
papers.tldr: 施工楼层等拥挤空间中，终身多智能体路径规划需应对目标与作业占用持续变化，作业耦合会改变遭遇空间并引发改道连锁。本文提出WP，依据实时宽度与遭遇需求构建共享通道和有序锚点，以紧迫度更新协调连续遭遇，并保留个体贪心运动。实验显示，WP在占用变化后仍维持路径延续并清空智能体，近停短暂；5至10智能体下平均到达数比最佳基线高25.2%至52.2%，计算时间低于滚动时域K_CBS。其贡献是统一共享空间分配与条件局部清空，从实时空间维护局部通行关系，拓展终身规划到作业运动耦合场景。
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong multiagent path planning on construction floors must accommodate continually changing goals and work occupancy. Existing planners can update paths and timing online, but work motion space coupling changes the spatial basis of unfinished encounters, while rerouting affects later encounters. Planning must therefore construct and maintain local encounter possibility. We propose Width based Planning with Compatible Encounter Space Allocation (WP), which constructs shared passage relationships from actual encounter demands and real time widths. Shared channels, ordered anchors, and urgency based updates coordinate successive encounters while retaining individual greedy motion between them. A necessary and sufficient width condition for fixed-point position exchange and a necessary directional condition for composite exchange provide geometric grounds for channel construction and encounter relocation. In crowded floor computational experiments, WP maintained route continuation after occupancy changes and enabled multi agent clearing, with infrequent, brief near stops. Complete run comparisons with four methods showed 25.2% to 52.2% more mean goal arrivals than the best baseline at each configuration of 5 to 10 agents, with lower mean computation time than the rolling horizon K_CBS adaptation. The contribution is a planning principle that constructs and continuously maintains local passage relationships from real time space, unifying shared spatial allocation and conditional local clearing to extend lifelong planning to work motion space coupling.

papers.title_en: Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Shared Spatial Fields
papers.evidence: 基于共享空间场的大规模终身多智能体路径规划强化学习策略
papers.tldr: 终身多智能体路径规划（LMAPF）在大规模动态交通与多样布局下需低成本决策。本文提出共享空间场导航策略：卷积网络每步只算一次地图共享场，再用紧凑的目标条件算子生成各智能体运动偏好。策略以吞吐量为奖励，通过平均奖励强化学习端到端训练，无需规划器示范或在线路径规划。在六个布局、10000智能体上吞吐量不逊于最强基线，且每步执行低于10毫秒，比多种经典规划器快一个数量级以上。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale applications of lifelong multi-agent path finding (LMAPF) call for computationally inexpensive movement decisions under changing traffic conditions and across varied layouts. We propose a navigation policy in which a convolutional network computes a shared spatial field over the map once per timestep and a compact goal-conditioned operator derives agents' movement preferences. The complete policy is trained end-to-end using average-reward reinforcement learning with throughput as the reward, without planner demonstrations or a separate online path planner. For structured and unstructured layouts, we train one policy per class on mixtures of small maps and deploy each without retraining on larger, unseen layouts and agent populations. Across six layouts with 10000 agents, our policies achieve throughput comparable to or higher than the strongest evaluated baselines. The proposed method has an average execution time below 10 ms per step, more than an order of magnitude faster than several established planners.

papers.title_en: Akule: Fast and Scalable Multi-Robot Motion Planning via Sparse Interaction Diffusion
papers.authors: Manav Vora, Gokul Puthumanaillam, Aditya Penumarti, Jane Shin, Melkior Ornik
papers.evidence: 基于稀疏交互扩散的可扩展多机器人运动规划
papers.tldr: 扩散模型可为多机器人运动规划提供轨迹先验，但扩展到大规模团队需避免昂贵联合计算。Akule 以冻结单机器人先验为基础，学习稀疏成对修正、上下文选择器和带符号权重组合器，将交互选择与效果合成解耦。该方法在多个基准上取得有竞争力成功率，完整规划器加速最高25倍，支持零样本规模迁移与256机器人规划。消融表明学习式选择与组合能减少修复前冲突和下游修复开销。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide expressive trajectory priors for multi-robot motion planning (MRMP), but scaling them to large teams requires coordinating individual motions without expensive joint computation. We introduce Akule, a sparse interaction diffusion framework that augments a frozen single-robot prior with three learned modules: a reusable pairwise correction model $R_φ$, a contextual selector $U_ψ$ that determines which corrections to evaluate, and a composer $G_ω$ that combines their effects through context-dependent signed weights. This decomposition separates which interactions merit computation from how their effects should be combined into coordinated denoising updates. We train $R_φ$ using matched pairwise trajectory optimizations, then learn $G_ω$ and $U_ψ$ from physically optimized joint trajectories without requiring a prescribed ground-truth interaction graph. The resulting joint proposals are passed to a downstream search-based planner for validation and repair. Across diverse MRMP benchmarks, Akule achieves competitive planning success, complete-planner speedups of up to $25\times$, zero-shot population transfer, and successful planning with up to $256$ robots. Ablations further demonstrate that learned selection and composition reduce pre-repair conflicts and downstream repair effort relative to heuristic selection and uniform summation.

papers.title_en: CoPlanVLM: Coordinated Path Planning for a Robot Team using Vision Language Models
papers.authors: David R. Martin, Jared Paquet, Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque, Pramod Khargonekar, Kyle Volle, J. Humberto Ramos, Scott Nivison
papers.evidence: 机器人团队的协同路径规划
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能用自然语言指挥机器人团队，但空间推理弱，导致基于VLM的路径规划效果受限。CoPlanVLM面向双机器人团队，将单条自然语言指令与图像转化为协同路径，借助图像叠加标注、任务分类和任务特定思维链提升空间推理。在Gazebo仿真与Turtlebot 4实物上，其平均成功率达84.4%，最接近基线为50.0%；两者均成功的试验中，路径平均缩短27%。该工作验证了VLM用于多机器人协同规划的可行性，并开源代码。
papers.abstract_en: We present CoPlanVLM, which uses a Vision Language Model (VLM) to translate a single natural-language instruction and image into coordinated paths for a team of two robots. While VLMs offer a flexible, natural-language interface for commanding robot teams, their weak spatial reasoning has greatly limited VLM-based path planning. CoPlanVLM improves the VLM's spatial reasoning and path planning abilities through three components: (1) an image overlay marking both free space and obstacles, (2) task classification that selects the most appropriate low-level planner and reasoning prompt for each instruction, and (3) task-specific chain-of-thought reasoning that prompts the VLM to identify key objects, allocate roles, and verify routes are collision-free before committing to a plan. Together, these components enable the team to complete complex coordinated maneuvers requiring both robots and divide large tasks between robots to increase efficiency. CoPlanVLM also supports detailed maneuvers involving specific routes, loops, and coverage of large areas, as well as tasks requiring directional reasoning such as north/south or left/right. We validate CoPlanVLM in both Gazebo simulation and on physical Turtlebot 4 hardware. CoPlanVLM attains an average success rate of 84.4% compared to 50.0% for the closest baseline. On trials where both methods succeed, CoPlanVLM's paths are 27% shorter on average. Project code is available at https://github.com/AICPS/CoPlanVLM.

papers.title_en: Reinforcement Learning Based Heterogeneous Task Allocation Under Spatio-Temporal Environmental Uncertainty for Multi-Robot Teams
papers.authors: Xi Lin, Yaxuan Li, Paul Szenher, Brendan Englot
papers.evidence: 不确定性下的多机器人任务分配与协调
papers.tldr: 针对海上自主水面艇（ASV）在异构任务与时空扰动下的多机器人任务分配难题，本文建模了任务类型和出现时间各异、且受未知随机海洋扰动影响的多ASV协作场景。提出一种去中心化强化学习策略网络，通过训练提升对不确定性导致观测偏差的鲁棒性，并支持个体决策以适配异构任务需求。在多种任务比例、任务数量、机器人种类及每类数量配置的仿真实验中，该策略取得最低完工时间，并可扩展至100个机器人、400个任务的规模。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) have been increasingly deployed to perform different kinds of maritime tasks in recent years, which motivates the need for a reliable task allocation policy that can adapt to heterogeneous tasks and maritime disturbances. In this work, we formulate a multi-robot task allocation problem in which a team of ASVs with heterogeneous capabilities needs to complete tasks of different types and appearance times under unknown stochastic spatio-temporal uncertainties from maritime disturbances. We propose a decentralized Reinforcement Learning (RL) based policy network that is trained to be robust towards uncertainty-induced observation deviations, and is able to perform individual decision making that leads to efficient execution behaviors toward heterogeneous task requirements. We evaluate the proposed policy and four baseline methods in simulated experiments with varied proportions of different tasks types, numbers of tasks, robot species and robots per species. Experiment results show that our proposed policy achieves the lowest makespan and can be deployed to address scenarios with 100 robots and 400 tasks.

papers.title_en: Position: Beyond Training Time, Test-Time Coordination is Essential for Cooperative MARL
papers.authors: Dongsu Lee, Sooraj Sathish, Joonkyung Kim, Woojun Kim, Amy Zhang
papers.evidence: 仓储机器人协作式多智能体强化学习的测试时协调
papers.tldr: 论文指出，在仓库机器人等长时程、集中监控的协作多智能体系统中，CTDE 仅训练时用全局信息，执行期缺少协调通道，环境变化后团队难以重新对齐，形成“可恢复性缺口”。作者主张把测试时协调纳入问题定义，提出集中训练与混合执行（CTME）：部署时协调者观察全局状态并间歇发送高层信号，智能体仍本地行动。CTME 不是具体算法，而是显式规定团队级信息、信号形式与更新频率的问题框架，CTDE 是其极限情形。该立场强调，移除测试时通道只是建模选择，具备全局遥测且需应对漂移时不应默认。
papers.abstract_en: We argue that cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) should treat test-time coordination as part of the problem definition rather than a deployment artifact. Our focus is on long-horizon, centrally monitored cooperative systems such as warehouse robotics, automated storage-and-retrieval systems, and cloud-resource scheduling, where teams share a reward, operate under shifting objectives, and already run with global telemetry at deployment. The dominant paradigm in this regime, centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE), uses global information only during training and provides no coordination channel at execution. This is sufficient when agents are weakly coupled or the environment is stationary, but it fails when the team must realign after conditions change. The limitation is structural rather than algorithmic, and more training cannot add a channel that does not exist at execution time. We call this the recoverability gap. To address it, we name the underexplored design space of intermittent test-time coordination as centralized training with mixed execution (CTME), in which a coordinator observes global state and emits high-level signals while agents act locally. CTME is not a particular learning algorithm, but a cooperative MARL problem setting that makes test-time information structure explicit. It specifies team-level information, high-level signals, and update frequency after training, with CTDE recovered as a limit case. We do not argue that CTDE is obsolete. We argue that removing the test-time channel is a modeling choice, not a necessity, and the wrong default when global telemetry is available and teams must recover from drift.

papers.title_en: Mobility-Budget-Constrained Submodular Maximization for Distributed Semantic Multi-Robot Exploration
papers.authors: Changxuan Yao, Sandilya Sai Garimella, Lu Gan, Panagiotis Tsiotras
papers.evidence: 结合资源感知贪心协调的分布式语义多机器人探索
papers.tldr: 多机器人探索在通信与移动约束下需兼顾信息增益与可达性。本文提出分布式语义探索框架，融合Dirichlet地图、预算约束轨迹选择与RAG协调，每机器人对前沿聚类并用单次预算受限Dijkstra求地形与朝向感知最小代价路径，按Dirichlet熵期望下降选路。十次网格实验与照片级仿真显示覆盖率、语义mIoU与地图确定性提升，且是唯一遵守单轨迹移动预算的方法。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-robot exploration under communication and mobility constraints requires balancing information gain with reachability. We present a distributed semantic exploration framework that combines Dirichlet mapping, budget-constrained trajectory selection, and Resource-Aware distributed Greedy (RAG) coordination. Each robot clusters frontiers, computes terrain- and heading-aware least-cost paths with a single budget-limited Dijkstra search, and selects feasible paths by marginal information gain, represented by the expected reduction in Dirichlet entropy. Each robot's per-round selection is exact, the team's joint per-round information gain is at least half the centralized optimum, and the bound degrades gracefully under limited communication. Ten-run gridworld ablations show improved coverage, semantic mIoU, and map certainty with lower entropy and traversal cost per unit distance than shortest-distance frontier selection. Budget-sensitivity experiments show that an intermediate budget best balances path reach and receding-horizon execution. In photorealistic full-system simulation against five coordination rules run in their native published forms, the proposed method attains the highest mean coverage and semantic accuracy while being the only one that respects the per-trajectory mobility budget.

papers.title_en: Red-Teaming of Vision-Language-Action Models via Quality Diversity Environment Generation
papers.authors: Shihan Zhao, Henry Chen, Ya-Chuan Hsu, Minjune Hwang, Siddharth Srikanth, Freddie Liang, Akanksha Saran, Aaquib Tabrez, Stefanos Nikolaidis, Daniel Seita
papers.evidence: 用质量多样性优化生成机器人环境以提升VLA行为鲁棒性
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在分布内表现良好，却易受物体位置、光照、纹理和相机位姿等测试时微小偏移影响。为此，作者提出 Q-DEG，利用质量多样性优化生成高失败率且多样的对抗环境，并用 VLA 自身成功轨迹进行自模仿微调。在三个代表性 VLA 模型上，Q-DEG 相比基线和两种红队基线微调方法，提升了对分布外对抗环境的鲁棒性，并促进了仿真到现实迁移。
papers.abstract_en: A long-standing goal in robotics is to develop generalist robots that can perform tasks across a wide range of settings, flexibly specified with images and text. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising path toward this goal by training on large collections of robot demonstrations. However, while VLAs perform well in-distribution, they often fail under minor test-time shifts, such as changes in object positions, lighting, textures, and camera poses. To address this, we propose Quality Diversity for Diverse Environment Generation (Q-DEG), a method for improving VLA robustness by generating adversarial environments and fine-tuning the VLA on its own successful rollouts. Q-DEG uses Quality Diversity (QD) optimization to find a set of high-failure environments, while promoting diversity using policy embeddings extracted from the VLA. These environments expose vulnerabilities that can be mitigated through self-imitation fine-tuning, thereby improving the VLA's robustness. In simulation, we conduct experiments across three representative VLA models, and our results indicate that Q-DEG improves robustness to out-of-distribution (OOD) adversarial environments compared to the base VLA and VLAs fine-tuned using data collected from two red-teaming baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate that improving VLA robustness through Q-DEG facilitates sim-to-real transfer. Our anonymous project website is at: https://qd-env.github.io/qdeg/.

papers.title_en: Before We Act: Learning Action-Conditioned Team-Response Beliefs for Decentralized Multi-Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Zihao Li, Yanan Zhou, Ranpeng Qiu, Guoqiang Ren, Weiming Zhi
papers.evidence: 去中心化多机器人操作协调
papers.tldr: 多机器人操作中，动作价值取决于队友如何响应，但分散式决策难以预测这种适应。CARE 从局部历史学习动作条件化团队响应信念，用预测编码器和匹配反应/重放延续分离直接优势与队友适应贡献；候选条件读出学习响应分布，校准选择决定是否调整标称动作。在 RoboFactory、MARS Control Track 和真实协作任务上，CARE 平均成功率最高，显式响应监督改善候选排序并降低选择遗憾，证明预测队友适应可转化为有效的分散式动作选择。
papers.abstract_en: In multi-robot manipulation, an action's value depends on how teammates respond. We present \method{} (Cooperative Action--Response Belief Estimation), a framework for learning \emph{team-response beliefs} from local history. A predictive belief encoder represents the interaction and conditions a nominal action. Matched reactive and replay continuations separate each candidate's direct advantage from the utility contributed by teammate adaptation. A candidate-conditioned readout learns this response distribution alongside total advantage, and calibrated selection chooses an alternative or retains the nominal action. Our analysis characterizes when response changes the preferred action and how prediction and source errors limit the recoverable gain. With the representation, proposals, and data fixed, explicit response supervision improves candidate ranking and reduces selection regret relative to learning the same information through branch utilities. The benefit is concentrated in decisions where teammate adaptation changes the preferred action. Across RoboFactory, the MARS Control Track, and physical collaboration tasks, CARE achieves the highest average success among the evaluated policies, combining a capable nominal policy with selective coordination adjustments. Together, these results show that CARE turns predictions of teammate adaptation into effective decentralized action selection. Project page: https://jeong-zju.github.io/care/.

papers.title_en: Training-Free Multi-Agent Cooperative Embodied Search from Uncertain Vision-Language Priors
papers.authors: Fan Pu, Keshu Wu, Jiwan Jiang, Shiyu Shen, Zhiwen Fan, Zhengzhong Tu, Jiachen Li, Yang Zhou
papers.evidence: 免训练多智能体协作多目标搜索
papers.tldr: 真实VLN在部分可观测下依赖不完整或错误的视觉语言先验，多智能体多目标搜索困难。本文提出免训练、不确定性感知的协作框架，用MLLM仅生成语义区域与目标线索，再以图优化在线校正。滚动时域混合整数线性规划与字典序目标联合规划，优先目标奖励并降低距离、不确定边和重复访问。在Matterport3D百例测试中提升覆盖与效率，负载更均衡，且无需重训练可泛化扩展。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to act under partial observability, where map structure, semantic cues, and target locations may be incomplete or incorrectly inferred by foundation models. This paper presents a lightweight, training-free, and uncertainty-aware framework for cooperative multi-agent multi-target search in mapless environments. Instead of learning an end-to-end navigation policy, the framework separates high-level semantic reasoning from low-level execution through a scalable graph-optimization backbone. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) serve only as hypothesis generators, proposing semantic zones, target-location cues, and possible navigable connections. These outputs are treated as uncertain priors and further refined using online observations and graph-context evidence. Cooperative navigation is then formulated as a rolling-horizon multi-agent mixed-integer linear program with a lexicographic objective that first maximizes target-directed reward and then reduces travel distance, uncertain-edge use, and repeated visits. Experiments derived from 100 Matterport3D test cases show that the proposed framework improves target coverage and search efficiency over representative baseline methods, while shared information and joint planning enable more balanced workloads across agents. By operating on an abstract graph without relying on embodiment-specific policy parameters, the framework scales across varying numbers of agents and targets, generalizes to unseen environments, and accommodates different perception modules and low-level controllers without task-specific retraining.

papers.title_en: CALM: Decentralized Control of Cooperative Aerial Manipulation with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Jiaxi Huo, Petre Ricioppo, Fausto Francesco Lizzio
papers.evidence: 多智能体强化学习协作多机器人控制
papers.tldr: 多无人机协同吊运篮筐并跟踪地面机器人时，风扰、负载运动和噪声目标广播会通过共享负载耦合各机，控制难度大。CALM 采用参数共享的多智能体强化学习策略，结合目标估计、单机扩张状态观测器、篮筐质量估计与前瞻编队偏航前馈。在留出轨迹上，其平均位置误差 7.68 cm、姿态误差 3.3°，优于机械臂基线 10.95 cm 和 4.7°及两个模型控制器。该工作实现分散执行下的协同空中操作，并在信息路径退化时保持竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative aerial manipulation is difficult under wind, payload motion, and noisy goal broadcasts because multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are coupled through a shared payload. We present CALM (Cooperative Aerial Learned Manipulation), a decentralized controller for aerial manipulators carrying a basket while tracking a moving ground robot. CALM combines a parameter-shared Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policy, trained using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO), with goal estimation, per-UAV Extended State Observers (ESOs), basket-mass estimation, and anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward. The anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward uses estimated goal motion to rotate the formation before position error develops, reducing basket-yaw lag without adding net commanded force. A disturbance-conditioned critic supports centralized training while execution remains decentralized. Across held-out trajectories, CALM achieves lower mean position and orientation errors than all evaluated baselines, including the matched arm baseline (7.68 versus 10.95 cm and 3.3 versus 4.7$^\circ$), the cable-suspended realization, and two model-based controllers. Under unseen full-information-path degradation, CALM remains statistically comparable or superior to the arm baseline. Videos are available at https://petreric.github.io/CALM/.

papers.title_en: Optimizing Team Behavior via Extremum-seeking Control in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体协调的自适应行为多样性控制
papers.tldr: 在协作多智能体强化学习中，行为多样性有助于角色分工，但其合适水平依赖任务且难以调参。ADiCo 采用双时间尺度在线自适应：快尺度 DiCo 将系统多样性调节到目标值，慢尺度极值搜索控制器仅用平均回合回报调整该目标。在两项协作 MARL 任务的六种配置上，ADiCo 能按需维持低或高多样性，性能匹配或超过网格搜索最优的 DiCo 与无约束 DiCo。这表明引入经典反馈控制可为多样性目标选择提供系统化替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents must learn to coordinate their actions to achieve shared objectives. A key indicator of effective coordination is behavioral diversity, i.e., the agents' potential to enact distinct yet complementary control policies given the same set of observations. Although behavioral diversity can enable role specialization and richer joint behaviors, its appropriate level is highly context- and task-dependent and often costly to tune. We propose Adaptive Diversity Control (ADiCo), a two-timescale framework that adapts behavioral diversity online during training. On a fast timescale, Diversity Control (DiCo) regulates system diversity toward a target value. On a slower timescale, an Extremum Seeking Controller (ESC) adjusts this target using only mean episodic returns, without requiring an explicit model or analytical gradient of the diversity-performance landscape. We evaluate ADiCo on six configurations across two cooperative MARL tasks, where it maintains task-appropriate diversity levels: low diversity when homogeneous policies are beneficial and higher diversity when heterogeneous policies are required. Through this adaptation, ADiCo matches or exceeds the mean performance of DiCo (best grid-searched diversity target) and Unconstrained DiCo (diversity allowed to emerge without target regulation). These results demonstrate that incorporating classical feedback control into MARL training enables effective coordination by providing a systematic alternative to task-specific manual selection of the diversity target.

papers.title_en: Collaborative Planning for UAV-UGV Teams under Operational Constraints via Masked Error-bounded Neuro-Symbolic Diffusion
papers.authors: Zihao Deng, Qianhuang Li, Maggie Wigness, John Rogers, Donghyun Kim, Hao Zhang
papers.evidence: 异构机器人团队的协同规划
papers.tldr: UAV-UGV异构团队在作业约束下协同规划面临挑战：UAV续航有限，UGV可作移动充电站但受路网约束。现有掩码扩散模型依赖熵引导调度与可微约束，难以兼顾约束执行与并行协同。本文提出MEND，将协同规划建模为条件掩码生成过程，并用逻辑诱导可采纳性指标重加权动作分布，同时以误差有界推理调度选择低预测熵位置解掩码。仿真、真实地图与实机实验表明MEND提升约束下协同规划性能。
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative planning under operational constraints is essential for heterogeneous robot teams in large-scale missions. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) provide rapid area coverage but are limited by onboard energy, while Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) can serve as mobile recharging stations yet are constrained by road-network traversability. Effective collaboration must enforce operational constraints during execution while enabling parallel, coordinated actions. Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) have shown promise through token unmasking but have two key limitations: entropy-guided scheduling assumes distributional alignment and reliance on differentiable constraints for diffusion-time optimization. We propose Masked Error-bounded Neuro-Symbolic Diffusion (MEND), which formulates collaborative planning as a conditional masked generative process to generate context-aware action sequences for UAV-UGV teams. MEND introduces a neuro-symbolic diffusion paradigm that constrains conditional masked diffusion policies at execution by reweighting the learned action distribution with a logic-induced admissibility indicator, thereby enforcing compliance with operational constraints. MEND introduces an error-bounded inference scheduling at execution that constructs the unmasking schedule by selecting positions with minimal predictive entropy over the constraint-aware action distribution, enhancing collaborative planning optimality under operational constraints. Extensive experimental results in simulation, on real-world maps, and with physical robot teams demonstrate that MEND advances UAV-UGV collaborative planning under operational constraints.

papers.title_en: ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models
papers.authors: Ke Wu, Hanwen Huang, Bo Gu, Kaizhao Zhang, Xiangting Meng, Yupeng Zheng, Zijun Xu, Jieru Zhao, Wenchao Ding
papers.evidence: 面向机器人策略与未来预测的世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型（WAM）用稠密未来预测增强稀疏动作监督，但可预测的未来多由外观与场景持续性主导，而非动作相关动态。本文提出动作切向场（Action Tangent Fields），在 Residual-VAE 空间用动作条件世界模型（ACWM）探测动作变化与残差世界变化之间的一阶局部对应，并将其蒸馏进 WAM 以引导去噪监督聚焦动作耦合方向。在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 与 RoboTwin2.0-Plus 上，该方法对光照、背景、相机、布局等扰动均取得一致性鲁棒性提升，且在无大规模具身预训练下部分分布偏移上超过预训练策略，并将多步 VideoDiT 去噪蒸馏为单步高效推理。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAM) improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction. However, much of the predictable future is dominated by appearance and scene persistence rather than action-dependent dynamics. We observe that several recent WAM designs, including optical flow, motion-centric representations, and latent actions, can be understood from a common perspective in which world supervision becomes more efficient as it contains a higher proportion of action-relevant variation. Based on this insight, we introduce Action Tangent Fields, which reformulate world supervision through a local Taylor expansion of how actions induce changes in future dynamics. We represent future dynamics in Residual-VAE space, where the future latent remains recoverable from the current latent and its residual, and use a strong action-conditioned world model (ACWM) to probe the local correspondence between action variations and residual-world variations. This local first-order structure is distilled into the WAM to guide its denoising supervision toward dynamics that are more tightly coupled to action, rather than merely predictable from appearance. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboTwin2.0-Plus, our method consistently improves robustness to lighting, background, camera, layout, and other environmental perturbations. Despite using no large-scale embodied pretraining, it achieves stronger robustness under several distribution shifts than pretrained policies. We further distill multi-step VideoDiT denoising into a single step for efficient inference. Our results suggest that effective WAM supervision should remain information-rich while concentrating its predictive capacity on the directions along which actions change the future.

papers.title_en: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Hongrui Zheng, Aditya Singh, Rahul Mangharam
papers.evidence: 受限多智能体强化学习协调
papers.tldr: 合作多智能体任务常需满足共享安全约束，但团队级违规代价无法区分各智能体动作的责任。SafeDiSTL 用信号时序逻辑（STL）鲁棒性度量回合级违规，并通过平滑全回合鲁棒性与可微动力学得到动作敏感度，将每个代价增量按延迟效应分摊给各智能体。在协同载运、连通导航和网络交通控制中，安全成功率分别提升1.6-5.1倍、11.1%，交通吞吐提高50-68%。该框架在保留无约束策略性能的同时，显著改善共享约束下的策略学习。
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.

papers.title_en: Persistent LLM Orchestration of Heterogeneous Robot Teams via Partial Delegation to Multi-Agent Protocols
papers.authors: Maria G. Mendoza, Victoria M. Tuck, Zachary Ravichandran, Shankar Sastry, George J. Pappas
papers.evidence: 通过多智能体协议编排异构机器人团队
papers.tldr: 现有LLM机器人团队编排多假设任务会终止且环境不变，在持续灾害响应中会出现提示无界增长、推理随智能体与目标增多而退化、覆盖一次后停止监控。本文提出持续编排框架：用从语义地图重建的马尔可夫状态摘要替代交互历史，将部分机器人委托给自主多智能体协议，并显式提示观测陈旧性及任务/事件触发重提示。在带蔓延火灾和移动撤离者的城市搜救仿真中，该框架救出98%平民，最强基线为89%，且token用量少六倍。消融实验进一步分离各机制贡献。
papers.abstract_en: Natural language specifications let non-expert users task robot teams, and large language models (LLMs) have recently proven effective at grounding such semantic specifications into plans for heterogeneous teams. Existing approaches assume missions that terminate and environments that, while unknown, do not change, but both assumptions fail in many emerging applications. For example, a disaster-response mission does not terminate, and its environment changes continuously as hazards spread and evacuees move. We identify three ways an LLM orchestrator breaks in this setting: its prompt grows without bound, its reasoning degrades as agents and targets accumulate, and it stops actively monitoring after covering the search space once. We build on the successful framework of grounded generative intelligence, and address each issue with a classical idea. A Markovian state summary, rebuilt from the semantic map at every invocation, replaces the growing interaction history. Partial delegation lets the orchestrator assign a subset of robots to an autonomous multi-agent protocol and reserve its reasoning for generating subtasks that require detailed parameters and careful ordering. Lastly, observation staleness, surfaced explicitly in the prompt, together with task-and event-triggered re-prompting, keeps the team vigilant. In a simulated urban search-and-rescue mission with spreading fire and moving evacuees, our framework rescues 98% of civilians versus 89% for the strongest baseline while using six times fewer tokens. Additional ablations isolate the contribution of each mechanism.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Event-Triggered Model Predictive Coverage Control with Average Update-Rate Regulation
papers.authors: Pengbo Zhu, Jicheng Shi, Colin N. Jones, Andreas A. Malikopoulos
papers.evidence: 多智能体覆盖控制的事件触发模型预测控制
papers.tldr: 多智能体模型预测覆盖控制需在通信与计算预算内兼顾优化负载和空间优先级响应，但固定事件阈值会使更新率随工况漂移，难以维持规定平均更新预算。为此提出阈值自适应事件触发MPC，按目标平均周期与最近事件间隔之差在线调节阈值，并证明经验平均更新周期收敛到任意可行目标。五智能体移动密度实验中，自适应策略平均204.7次全局MPC更新，接近目标200，优于固定阈值的266.7次，且覆盖代价更低。该机制实现了平均更新预算的直接调节与任务相关调度。
papers.abstract_en: Model predictive coverage control for multi-agent systems operates under tight communication and computation budgets, which requires it to balance the load of optimization against responsiveness to varying spatial priorities. With a fixed event threshold, the update rate varies with operating conditions, making a prescribed average update budget difficult to maintain. We propose threshold-adaptive event-triggered model predictive control (MPC), which adjusts the threshold online in proportion to the difference between the target average period and the latest inter-event interval. We prove convergence of the empirical average update period to any feasible prescribed target and establish initialization-dependent one-sided bounds on the cumulative average. A nonlinear benchmark illustrates these budget guarantees. We then apply the mechanism to coverage MPC using a task-aware statistic that captures robot motion and changes in spatial importance. In a five-agent moving-density study, the adaptive policy uses 204.7 global MPC updates on average against a target of 200, compared with 266.7 for a fixed-threshold policy using the same statistic and initial threshold. It also reduces coverage cost relative to periodic schedules with exactly matched update counts. These results demonstrate direct average-budget regulation and effective task-dependent scheduling of MPC updates.
